correctness.rationale: The unique rational polynomial follows from a nonsingular 2N+1 Hermite interpolation system. Direct substitution verifies all N distinct prime-three orbits. At their first two phases the same rank-one Jacobian J with J²=0 occurs, so the three-step derivative vanishes and a local quadratic contraction gives open attracting basins. The universal Jacobian cube vanishes identically. Fixed and period-two exclusions follow from polynomial conjugacy. The standalone rational checker executes 267 checks for N=1..6, supplemental to the general algebraic proof.

value.rationale: Unboundedly many simultaneous stable periodic attractors resolve the published motivating uniqueness question in the negative, with rational coefficients, a quantitative degree bound and zero-multiplier robustness. This is a motivated structural counterexample in a restrictive everywhere-nilpotent-Jacobian family, not an isolated arbitrary numerical instance.
